title: Gold swing
assumptions: Gold = XAUUSD price action, replayed on COMEX gold futures (Yahoo GC=F), the closest free intraday history. Futures trade a few dollars away from spot (the basis), so levels differ slightly from your broker's XAUUSD chart; structure and timing are the same. Times are shown in IST.

Gold swing = your swing playbook on gold: daily structure, 1H confirmation (rejection in the zone, close back over the 9 EMA on 1.5x volume), long AND short (shorts are found on the mirrored chart with the same rules), stop beyond the daily order block with a 0.25 ATR buffer, T1 1R half (no early breakeven), T2 2R a quarter with the stop to entry, T3 3R, closed after 28 days.

The weekly-trend (against the trade) and 2R-room hold-backs are applied. Costs: 0.35 dollars per ounce on a round trip (spread plus commission), taken off every trade in R. Overnight swap or financing on held positions is NOT modelled.

montecarlo.note: Not enough trades for a simulation (need 20).

scenarios.name: A+, your rules: 2 a day, more only if A+
